issues.description: The template Stock class exposes getStockIngredients() returning a List<StockIngredient>, while the solution Stock class exposes getStockIngredients() returning a StockIngredient[] array. The problem statement's UML/method list does not specify this accessor, so the differing return types between template and solution create an inconsistent shape for the same API and may confuse students comparing template code with the reference solution or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Standardize the getStockIngredients() API across template and solution. Either change the template's getStockIngredients() to return StockIngredient[] (to match the solution) or update the solution to return List<StockIngredient>. Also update the problem statement to explicitly document the intended accessor signature so students have a single clear target.
